text:
Diego (Product): Quick heads-up: AcmeCorp pushed for a pilot that needs 99.9% availability, EU data residency, and a hard cost cap per 1M tokens. We need cross-team tradeoffs and a recommended cut for MVP.
Rina (Program): Breaking this down: infra + runtime capacity, security/compliance for residency, analytics for SLA measurement, product for contract terms. Can each team call out blockers?
Priya (Infra): EU pool exists but tenant isolation + billing segregation not wired. We can do network isolation + separate billing tags but provisioning lead time ~10 business days. Cost delta estimate: +18% for dedicated regional pool.
Theo (Runtime): Runtime work: per-tenant KV namespaces, warm-up token prefetch, and a new admission limit so a noisy tenant doesn't push others. Estimate: 4 dev days + 2 for canary metrics. Need infra hooks for namespace allocation.
Sam (Security): Residency requires logs never leave eu-west S3; key ops need HSM in-region. Also need updated dataflow diagram and SOC-type checklist. Can produce a checklist but HSM procurement may add lead time.
Nora (Analytics): To verify SLA we'll need p50/p95 telemetry by tenant + model variant. We can add labels to traces but need runtime tagging support (model_variant, tenant_id). ETA for dashboards: 3 days once tags exist.
Diego (Product): The customer will only accept p95 < 350ms for <64-token prompts. Can we satisfy that with rn-7b and a quantized rn-13b fallback?
Theo (Runtime): rn-7b hits that on dedicated low-concurrency pools with prefetch. rn-13b quantized (int8) can be close but will need generation-quality checks. Suggest canary: 5% traffic rn-13b-q then ramp.
Priya (Infra): Note: EU physical hosts are oversubscribed next week. If we commit today we can reserve a slot two weeks out; otherwise queue increases. Need PO to schedule.
Rina (Program): Timeline constraints noted. Product: decide whether to accept +18% cost and 2-week provisioning. Also confirm go/no-go gating.
Diego (Product): Recommend we take the cost and EU residency. Ask: what are the hard blockers to shipping in 3 weeks?
Sam (Security): HSM in-region and signed audit stream to customer-controlled bucket. If procurement for HSM delays, we can offer temporary KMS solution with restricted access but customer compliance may reject.
Theo (Runtime): Canary plumbing and namespace allocation are blockers; dev time minimal but integration testing with infra is required. Also we need a feature flag for model_pin and routing fallback.
Nora (Analytics): Without runtime tags we can't claim tenant-level SLA. That's a gating requirement for the contract.
Priya (Infra): Blocker: PO + SOW amendment for EU capacity and billing segregation. Also need runbook for cross-region failover.
Diego (Product): OK action items: 1) Priya: PO + provisional capacity reservation (today). 2) Theo: runtime PR for KV namespaces, prefetch, and model_pin flags (ETA Tue). 3) Sam: provisional checklist + temporary KMS fallback note (ETA Fri). 4) Nora: dashboard templates and tag requirements (ETA Wed). 5) Rina: draft SOW addendum for EU residency and cost delta (ETA Mon).
Rina (Program): I'll consolidate owners into the project plan and add a go/no-go review on day 10.
ci-bot: Created pipeline job: tenant-pilot-canary. Tests included: perf-smoke, kv-namespace, model-pin.
Theo (Runtime): Performance note: warm-up token prefetch helps reduce cold-start tail but increases token cost. Recommend tight prefetch window (20 tokens) and TTL for prewarm state.
Sam (Security): Compliance note: key rotation 90 days minimum for this customer. I'll include rotation cadence in the checklist.
Priya (Infra): Billing segregation: we'll create a separate billing account + tags. That requires finance sign-off.
Diego (Product): Final: target go/no-go review in 10 business days. If we hit any blocker, flag here and Rina will triage. Thanks all :rocket:
